summary.tldr: Adds funeral services to the zero-rated tax list and creates a one-stop service for reporting a death.
what_it_does: Adds funeral services, including a coffin, headstone, or other related property, to the Excise Tax Act list of zero-rated supplies.
Repeals section 344 and section 360 of the Excise Tax Act.
Requires the Minister of Employment and Social Development to establish a one-stop service for reporting a death and sharing relevant information with partner entities.
Aims to reduce the administrative burden that follows a death.
summary.background: The bill amends the Excise Tax Act and the Department of Employment and Social Development Act.
